caption:
A schoolgirl hurls the ocean at a boy.
Every wave here came out of Seedance 2.5.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 25 seconds · 16:9 aspect ratio · ultra-realistic live-action action-comedy, bright sunny midday, crisp 4K, natural saturated colors (deep blue sky, turquoise sea, pale golden sand), hard sunlight with sharp shadows, 24-35mm lenses · camera: energetic low tracking shots at sand level, a fixed low-angle ending · pacing: fast slapstick, real time with slight slow motion on the big impacts.

CHARACTERS:
- THE BOY: East Asian young man, about 20, slim, messy black hair with a fringe, thin wire-rim glasses, black school blazer with a small chest emblem, white shirt untucked, loosened dark striped tie, black trousers, black shoes; tattoos on the backs of both hands, silver rings.
- THE GIRL: young woman, about 19, very long wavy blonde hair worn loose, navy-black school blazer with white piping and a chest emblem, white shirt with a red bow ribbon, dark red-and-navy plaid pleated mini skirt, white crew socks, black loafers. Signature: whenever the beach attacks him, she flings one arm out toward him, palm open, as if she is causing it.
LOCATION: a wide sunny city beach: broad pale golden sand, turquoise sea with white surf, a beachfront row of modern white and blue-glass high-rise hotels and apartment towers including a pair of tall dark-blue glass twin skyscrapers, and a green forested headland at the far end of the bay. Clear blue sky. Nobody else on the beach.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:03.6) — The chase. Low side tracking shot at sand level, moving left to right with them: the girl runs at left, the boy sprints ahead at right, sea and headland behind, towers at left. At 00:01.5 his front foot digs into the sand and he pitches forward, hands slamming down in a spray of sand; he scrambles back up and keeps running while she keeps chasing, reaching after him.
SHOT 2 (00:03.6-00:09.7) — Sand blast. Front tracking shot, camera backing up ahead of them, beachfront high-rises and the twin towers behind. He runs at the camera, she follows behind him. MUST SHOW: at 00:04.3 a column of sand taller than a person bursts straight up from the beach just left of him as she throws her hand out; he looks back over his shoulder, the sand blast sweeps sideways into him and he flies forward; the camera whips right to follow as he crashes face-first into the sand in a cloud of dust, rolls, ends on hands and knees with his black suit coated in sand, pushes up and runs off right toward the water.
SHOT 3 (00:09.7-00:14.7) — Wide, low angle from the dry sand, slow tracking: both run along the waterline from left to right, she behind at left, he ahead at right, turquoise surf on the right, skyline at left, headland in the centre. At 00:12.0 she points her arm at the sea. MUST SHOW: a huge transparent mass of sea water lifts out of the ocean behind them and flies through the air, a glassy curling sheet of water hanging in the sky above the beach; he runs toward the camera.
SHOT 4 (00:14.7-00:20.9) — The wave. Front tracking shot, camera backing up: he runs at the camera, she behind at left. MUST SHOW: the giant airborne sheet of water stretched across the sky above them in front of the high-rises. He slows, turns and stares straight up at it; both stop. At 00:18.3 the whole water mass slams straight down on him in a crashing white wall that fills the frame, exploding into foam; as it clears he is knocked flat in the shallow foamy water, then sits up soaked, legs splayed, while she stands dry at left with one arm out.
SHOT 5 (00:20.9-00:25.1) — Ending. Locked-off low-angle medium shot at sand level, wet shiny sand and high-rises behind: the boy sits front and centre, soaked, legs spread, hands resting on his knees, hair dripping, glasses on, defeated deadpan; she stands behind at left, arm stretched out toward him. At 00:22.4 a big lump of wet sand drops from above straight onto his head with a splat and stays there like a hat, sand streaming down his face and shoulders; he doesn't move. She turns and walks away out of frame left, hair swinging, while he stays slumped.

SOUND: upbeat playful comedic instrumental beat; feet thumping on sand, heavy breathing, a sand thud and whoosh for the sand blast, a deep rushing roar as the water lifts, a huge crashing splash, surf hiss, a wet splat for the sand on his head, then waves only. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Ultra-realistic sunny city beach comedy, 16:9. A blonde schoolgirl chases a boy in a black blazer; with a flick of her hand sand erupts, a giant sheet of sea water flies overhead and crashes on him, then wet sand plops on his head.
